nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker ignore file listing files and directories to exclude from Docker build context for the WaveeMusic project.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-targeted guide defining the index, authoring conventions, and protocol-isolation invariant for all component guides under .agents/guides/, serving as the single source of truth for how LLM agents should navigate and extend the Wavee codebase documentation.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive LLM-agent instruction file covering architecture, commands, conventions, process model, AI features, testing, and proprietary exclusions — the primary guide for Claude Code working in the WaveeMusic repository.
nodes.languageNotes: 19 sections covering everything from build commands to anti-fraud telemetry mimicry conventions.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project-level overview of WaveeMusic — a clean-room Spotify desktop client for Windows — covering features, project structure, technology stack, gabo telemetry, quick-start instructions, and licensing.

nodes.name: decode_gabo.sh
nodes.summary: Developer diagnostic script that decodes base64-encoded Spotify gabo-receiver-service request bodies using protoc against the event_sender proto schemas to inspect telemetry payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Shell script using protoc (Grpc.Tools) to decode PublishEventsRequest protobufs; targets Windows x64 protoc binary path.
